params.description:

title: This tiny spider has MORE DNA than you. 50% more #Shorts

params.title: This tiny spider has MORE DNA than you. 50% more #Shorts
params.description:
A coin-sized California trapdoor spider has a genome roughly 50% larger than a human's: 4.6 billion base pairs and 52 chromosomes (we have 46). But about 77% is repetitive DNA, which is why genome size doesn't measure complexity.
